definitions.explanation: A large, open-topped bag with parallel handles, used for carrying everyday items. From English 'tote bag.'

examples.japanese: トートバッグに{荷物|にもつ}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put my things in the tote bag.

examples.japanese: {布|ぬの}のトートバッグを{買|か}い{物|もの}に{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use a cloth tote bag for shopping.

examples.japanese: レジ{袋|ぶくろ}が{有料|ゆうりょう}になってから、トートバッグを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Since plastic bags became paid, more people carry tote bags around.

notes:
A loanword from English 'tote bag.' In Japan, tote bags became especially popular after the introduction of charges for plastic shopping bags (レジ{袋|ぶくろ}{有料化|ゆうりょうか}) in 2020. Many people carry a folding tote bag as an eco-bag (エコバッグ) for shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {布|ぬの}のトートバッグ: cloth tote bag
- {革|かわ}のトートバッグ: leather tote bag
- トートバッグを{持|も}つ: to carry a tote bag
- {折|お}りたたみトートバッグ: folding tote bag

RELATED WORDS:
- エコバッグ: eco-bag; reusable shopping bag — often a tote bag used as a plastic bag replacement
- {手提|てさ}げ{袋|ぶくろ}: handbag; carry bag — general term for any bag with handles
- ショルダーバッグ: shoulder bag — worn over the shoulder, unlike a tote
